traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Structure meets dream. Grounding imagination into reality, or pessimism colliding with illusion. The trine makes this a natural strength: Dreams worked patiently into something real. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Limit and imagination flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what limit and imagination have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Disciplined vision realized over time; the task is managing fear.
shadow: The ease lets fear and rigidity and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
